sections.name: About Us
sections.copy:
About Winning Woman Pension Administrators

Winning Woman Retirement Services Limited operates from Morcas area, Obaagun, Osun State, providing comprehensive pension administration services across Nigeria. Led by experienced asset management professionals, we understand the unique retirement planning needs of Nigerian workers and business owners.

Our mission is to ensure every contributor receives maximum value from their pension investments through strategic asset management, transparent operations, and customer-focused service. We combine regulatory compliance with innovative investment strategies to deliver superior returns while maintaining the security of your retirement funds.

As a registered Pension Fund Administrator (PFA), we serve both Contributory Pension Scheme members and individuals seeking voluntary pension contributions. Our expertise in the Nigerian financial landscape positions us to navigate market dynamics and optimize your retirement portfolio.

sections.name: Our Services
sections.copy:
Comprehensive Pension Solutions

Contributory Pension Scheme Administration
We manage Retirement Savings Accounts (RSAs) for employees in both public and private sectors, ensuring seamless contribution management, accurate record-keeping, and timely benefit payments upon retirement.

Voluntary Contribution Management
Enhance your retirement income by making additional voluntary contributions. We provide flexible options for self-employed individuals and employees seeking to boost their pension savings beyond mandatory contributions.

Asset Management & Investment
Our expert team actively manages pension fund assets across diverse investment portfolios including Federal Government Securities, Corporate Bonds, and other PENCOM-approved instruments to maximize returns while minimizing risk.

Retirement Planning Advisory
Receive personalized guidance on retirement planning, benefit projections, and investment strategies tailored to your financial goals and risk profile. We help you understand your pension statements and make informed decisions.

Benefit Payment Processing
We facilitate efficient processing of retirement benefits, including programmed withdrawals, annuities, and lump sum payments in compliance with the Pension Reform Act.

Pension Transfer Services
Seamlessly transfer your existing RSA from another PFA to Winning Woman with minimal documentation and zero disruption to your retirement savings.

sections.name: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.copy:
Frequently Asked Questions

What is a Pension Fund Administrator (PFA)?
A PFA is a licensed entity that manages Retirement Savings Accounts (RSAs) on behalf of pension contributors. Winning Woman Retirement Services Limited is registered with PENCOM to provide these services.

How do I open an RSA with Winning Woman?
Simply contact us via phone or WhatsApp at +234 802 860 9132. We'll guide you through the simple registration process, which requires basic identification and employment details.

Can I switch from my current PFA to Winning Woman?
Yes! You can transfer your RSA to Winning Woman at any time. The process is straightforward, and we'll handle all documentation with your current administrator.

How are my pension contributions invested?
Your funds are invested in a diversified portfolio of PENCOM-approved instruments including government securities, corporate bonds, and money market instruments, managed by experienced asset management professionals.

When can I access my pension benefits?
You can access your retirement benefits upon reaching 50 years of age (or the retirement age specified by your employer), upon voluntary retirement, or in cases of temporary or permanent disability.

How often will I receive account statements?
Ye receive quarterly statements showing your account balance, contributions received, investment returns, and other relevant information.

What happens to my pension if I change jobs?
Your RSA moves with you throughout your career. Simply notify your new employer of your existing RSA details, and they'll continue making contributions to the same account.

Are there charges for pension administration?
Yes, administrative and investment management fees are charged as approved by PENCOM. These are clearly disclosed in your account statements and are competitive with industry standards.
